readOnlineOnlyHelp: OneDrive downloads every file the app reads. When off, online-only files are listed but not read.
onedrive: This folder is in OneDrive, which can keep files online only or remove their local copies.
onedriveHelp: To keep the music on this PC, right-click the folder in File Explorer and choose "Always keep on this device", or move the music out of OneDrive.
